description:
The client timings and constants the server relays (READY `call_keys.params` and every
[`CallKeysInit`]; S50 §9.4, S51 §20.1). The single source for client timings.

ciphersuites.description: The ciphersuites the server accepts (`[1]` in v1).

client_activate_fallback_ms.description: A sender that acked but hears no `activate` switches after this long.

exporter_label.description: The MLS exporter label of frame keys ([`tls::EXPORTER_LABEL`]).

key_package_max_lifetime_s.description: Longest KeyPackage lifetime the server accepts.

retire_after_ms.description: Receivers retire an old slot this long after `activate`.

unknown_call_buffer_ms.description: Dispatches for a `call_id` the client does not know yet are buffered this long.

title: CallKeysParams
